CAL_BUILD_DATA.improvementSuggestions:
TodayPage is the primary interface. Connect the 3 backend endpoints, add real-time updates, focus mode toggle. This single page delivers 80% of the product value. All backend intelligence (briefing, reality check, proactive interventions, schedule) surfaces here. Without it, the product is invisible. 3 days VERY HIGH
Show diff when Google/Outlook sync conflicts with local changes. Let user choose: keep local, keep remote, merge. Users will not trust a calendar that silently overwrites or duplicates events. This is table stakes for any calendar app. 3 days HIGH
80% of "AI" calls are fixed patterns ("create event", "move meeting"). Use keyword/pattern matching instead of LLM. Deterministic = faster (50ms vs 2s), cheaper ($0 vs API costs), no hallucination, testable. Reserve LLM only for truly ambiguous inputs. 2 days HIGH
ETag mismatch = overwrite local (line 198-214). Deleted events not handled (line 243-246: "simplified"). Implement proper delta sync with conflict UI. Silent data corruption destroys trust irrecoverably. Must fix before any real users. 3 days CRITICAL
Cut features that add decisions (rule writing, simulation comparison, memory management). Keep only: Morning "Here are your 3 priorities, here's when to do them", During day "Meeting in 10min — prep doc attached", Evening "You completed 2/3 priorities. Tomorrow's first block: 9-11 Deep Work". Differentiation is "The only calendar that tells you what to do, not just where to be." Every proactive insight must reduce a decision, not add one. Ongoing HIGH
<suggestion category="Differentiation" priority="2" title="Onboarding: Calendar Connect → Working Hours → First Briefing in < 3 Minutes"> Guided flow: OAuth → timezone detection → working hours slider → generates first morning briefing immediately. Users drop at "connect calendar." Time-to-value must be under 3 minutes. Show the magic immediately. 3 days HIGH
Calendar, Select, Tabs, Progress, Badge, Tooltip, Avatar, Skeleton, Table, Form (React Hook Form + Zod). These unblock ALL remaining pages. Currently building pages without components leads to inconsistent, buggy UI. Invest 2 days in component library, save 10+ days on page implementation. 2 days HIGH
Standardize: useQuery hook, loading/error/empty states, optimistic updates, Zod validation. Apply to TodayPage first, then replicate. Eliminates repeated bugs, ensures consistency, makes new pages take hours not days. 1 day HIGH
Phase 19 (Simulation Engine) is complex with no UI. Replanning engine already provides A/B/C options. Use that instead. Simulation is a "nice to have" power-user feature. Replanning covers 90% of what-if needs with simpler UX. 0 (defer) LOW
Users don't write rules in English; they click toggles. Replace with toggle-based constraints UI in Settings. Phase 12 NL rules engine is a gimmick. Toggle UI is faster to build, easier to use, less error-prone. 0 (defer) LOW
Keep only explicit user memories (EXPLICIT_PREFERENCE, EXPLICIT_FACT, USER_RULE). Drop LEARNED_PATTERN, TEMPORARY_CONTEXT - they cause confusion. AI-inferred memories with confidence scores = user confusion. Manual entry only is clearer and safer. 0 (config change) MEDIUM
